pages.title: A Rare Currency
pages.text: Arcane Ink turns up seldom, and mostly as dungeon loot - a thick, faintly glowing vial of something that isn't quite ink and isn't quite blood. Whatever it actually is, the Hunger seems to want it.

pages.title: What It's For
pages.text: Beyond trading it away, Arcane Ink has no use of its own - it exists to be spent. If you can't find enough of it, a recipe does exist as a backup: a Nether Star, a Glass Bottle, and two Raw Arcane Material - a deliberately steep price for something meant to mostly come from dungeons instead.
